definitions.explanation: A hard casing applied around a broken bone or injured limb to hold it still while it heals.

examples.english: They put a cast on my leg.

examples.japanese: ⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ギプス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I broke a bone, so I got a cast on my arm.

examples.japanese: ギプス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told it would take a month until the cast comes off.

notes:
From German "Gips" (gypsum, plaster), reflecting the historical influence of German on Japanese medical vocabulary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ギプス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はめる／⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put on a cast
- ギプス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧: the cast comes off
- ギプス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to wrap a cast (around a limb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{包帯|ほうたい}→包帯：05385_houtai⟧: bandage — soft cloth wrapping, not a rigid cast
- {添|そ}え{木|ぎ}: splint — a stiff support placed alongside a limb
